changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE product_image ( id uuid PRIMARY KEY, product_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, sha256 varchar(64) NOT NULL, content_type varchar(80) NOT NULL, content bytea NOT NULL, position integer NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL, UNIQUE (product_id, sha256) ); CREATE INDEX ix_product_image_product ON product_image(product_id, position);
